name: TOCCraft – Modern Table of Contents
author: Secil Kars

sections.description:
TOCCraft – Modern Table of Contents automatically generates a responsive, modern and lightweight table of contents from your post and page headings.

Features:

  • Automatic TOC generation from H2, H3 and H4 headings
  • Manual shortcode support: [toccraft_toc]
  • Per-page enable/disable control
  • Modern glass, minimal and boxed design styles
  • Collapsible TOC
  • Smooth scroll
  • Active heading highlight
  • No external dependency
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from WordPress admin
  3. Go to Settings > TOCCraft
  4. Configure automatic position or use [toccraft_toc]
